ai_generated_tags.description: The interior space features a modern take on Indian design with a focus on clean lines and natural wood tones. The wooden cabinets and built-in shelves utilize vertical space efficiently, blending traditional Indian craftsmanship with contemporary design. The use of white paneling adds a clean, modern touch to the room while the dark wood of the cabinets provides a warm, traditional accent. The overall aesthetic is elegant and functional, suitable for a living room in a contemporary home.

metadata.budget_indicator: Moderate to High, due to the use of quality materials like wood and paneling
metadata.functionality: Primary purpose is for living and storage, providing a relaxing environment for residents and guests
